Okay, so I'm trying to figure out which county Southern Maryland Electric Cooperative (SMECO) is headquartered in. From the conversation history, I see that several agents have been working on this problem, primarily using WebSurfer to search for the information.

Initially, the WebSurfer found an address for SMECO in Hughesville, MD, but there was confusion about the county. Then, the WebSurfer tried to verify the county by looking at the ZIP code, mistakenly thinking that 20637 is in St. Mary's County instead of Charles County. This seems to be the mistake because Hughesville is actually in Charles County, not St. Mary's.

So, the mistake was made in step 7 by WebSurfer when they incorrectly associated the ZIP code with St. Mary's County. The reason for the mistake is that they didn't cross-check the city with the correct county, leading to an incorrect conclusion.
